content.value_statement: Model upgrades can leave stale identifiers, unsupported headers, and prompts tuned for older Claude behavior. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a focused Opus 4.5 migration.
actual_capabilities: Finds Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 model identifiers.
Maps target Opus 4.5 identifiers for Anthropic API, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry.
Removes the unsupported 1M context beta header and adds a clear migration note.
Adds the Opus 4.5 effort beta configuration when requested by the migration flow.
Applies prompt adjustments for tool use, code exploration, design quality, and thinking sensitivity when relevant.
Summarizes model string changes and prompt modifications after migration.
limitations: It does not migrate Haiku models.
It does not run compatibility tests or deploy the updated application.
Prompt snippets should only be applied when the user reports a matching issue.
Effort configuration depends on the documented beta flag remaining available.

use_cases.title: Upgrade Anthropic API usage
use_cases.description: Replace older Claude model identifiers with Opus 4.5 identifiers and remove unsupported beta headers.

use_cases.title: Coordinate platform migrations
use_cases.description: Map Opus 4.5 model strings across Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry.

use_cases.title: Tune prompts after migration
use_cases.description: Adjust prompts for Opus 4.5 behavior when users report tool overuse, over-engineering, or generic frontend output.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Migration Scope
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a safe starting point.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my project for Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, or Opus 4.1 usage. Tell me what should change before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Update Model Strings
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate this codebase to Claude Opus 4.5. Update supported model strings, skip Haiku models, and summarize each changed file.

prompt_templates.title: Add Effort Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: After updating model identifiers, add high effort configuration where the Anthropic API request supports it. Explain any beta flag changes.

prompt_templates.title: Adjust Advanced Prompts
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced migration after behavior issues appear.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these system prompts for Opus 4.5 behavior issues. Apply only relevant changes for tool overuse, exploration, design quality, or thinking sensitivity.

output_examples.input: Migrate an Anthropic API project from Sonnet 4.5 to Opus 4.5.
output: Detected older Claude model identifiers in API calls.
Updated supported identifiers to Opus 4.5 for the active platform.
Removed the unsupported 1M context beta header and added a migration note.
Listed changed files and remaining verification steps.

output_examples.input: Fix prompts that overuse tools after the Opus 4.5 upgrade.
output: Found tool-triggering language that was stronger than needed.
Softened the instructions without changing the intended tool policy.

output_examples.input: Review a multi-cloud migration plan for Claude Opus 4.5.
output: Identified the platform-specific Opus 4.5 target for each provider.
Flagged Haiku references as out of scope for this migration.
Separated model updates from optional prompt tuning work.

best_practices: Start with model string updates before changing prompts.
Apply prompt snippets only when a reported issue matches the documented condition.
Summarize every model, header, effort, and prompt change for review.
anti_patterns: Do not migrate Haiku model identifiers with this skill.
Do not append every prompt snippet by default.
Do not remove existing functional prompt content while adding migration guidance.

faq.question: Which source models does this skill migrate?
faq.answer: It covers Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 migrations to Opus 4.5.

faq.question: Does it support Haiku migrations?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly excludes Haiku models from this migration path.

faq.question: Which providers are covered?
faq.answer: It documents Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry model identifiers.

faq.question: Will it always rewrite prompts?
faq.answer: No. Prompt adjustments are applied only when the user requests them or reports a matching behavior issue.

faq.question: What beta header does it remove?
faq.answer: It removes the 1M context beta header when present because it is not supported with Opus 4.5.

faq.question: Does it verify production behavior?
faq.answer: No. It guides migration edits and summaries, but testing and deployment remain user responsibilities.
